review_evidence: ComputeExamples.lean: Defines E4sq, E4E6, Δ, E4pow37 as ModularForm objects and certifies coefficients via qexp_coeff tactic
DeltaExamples.lean: Manual and macro-based proofs of Ramanujan τ(n) for n=0..20 using discriminant_qExpansion_coeff_via_generic
Examples.lean: Unified qexp_certify macro; definitions and coefficient theorems for E₄, E₆, E₄², E₄·E₆, Δ with certified examples

LMFDB_1_12_a_a.lean through LMFDB_1_22_a_a.lean: Each defines an LMFDB level-1 cusp form via polyData, proves qExpansion_eq_evalEisPS, derives coefficient theorem via qexp_coeff_via_E4E6, and provides Sturm-bound certificates (n=0,1)
LMFDB_1_24_a_a.lean: Algebraic form (degree 2); decomposes into f_rat + α·f_irrat, certifies 3 Sturm-bound coefficients, proves uniqueness theorem identifies_lmfdb_1_24_a_a
LMFDB_1_60_a_orbit.lean: Algebraic form (degree 5); 5 rational pieces f_60_part_0..4, certifies 6 Sturm-bound coefficients, proves uniqueness theorem identifies_lmfdb_1_60_a_orbit
summary: Inspected all 10 Lean files in LeanBridge/LMFDB/ModularForms. Every file contains substantial formal mathematical content: definitions of modular forms (as polynomials in E₄/E₆ or algebraic combinations), bridge lemmas connecting q-expansions to polynomial evaluations, theorems about q-expansion coefficients, certified coefficient proofs (via `qexp_certify` macro or manual `decide +kernel` patterns), and in several cases Sturm-bound uniqueness theorems identifying forms with LMFDB labels. No file is a pure import aggregator or lacks formal declarations/proofs.
